why: Every line is PASS, and each one names a concrete wrong build and why the line catches it. Line 1: changing nothing prints 'Hello, Ada!' (true, since bin/greet.js skips '--' args), and upper-casing only the name fails the HELLO, ADA! example. Line 2: upper-casing every greeting through greeting() in src/greet.js fails, and the existing 'greeting'/'cli' tests also catch it (true). Line 3: documenting only in README.md leaves docs/index.md unchanged and fails the read. The description of docs/index.md is accurate. Line 4: testing only a shout() helper, or adding no test, fails. 'node --test' and execFileSync in test/greet.test.js are real. The wrong_build summary names a concrete build (checking process.argv[2] === '--shout') and explains why it was not counted. Nothing cited is made up.
